phases.title: Freeze Evidence Authority And Family Boundaries
acceptance: evidence-family ownership is explicit for declaration, admission, graph, aspect, and obligation truth with no generic debug blob fallback
UiEvidenceIdentity, UiEvidenceRef, UiEvidenceHandle, and UiEvidenceSlice are semantically distinct and non-forgeable where required
family-local evidence records carry provenance to the owning authority artifact rather than inspector-local reinterpretation
public inspection surfaces remain facade-oriented and do not export family-local storage topology
phases.instructions: Freeze evidence authority first. Make the family vocabulary, ownership, provenance, and non-forgeable handle split explicit before relevance, indexing, or slice assembly broadens the substrate.
phases.qa_focus: No second truth graph, no generic evidence map, no public family internals, and no identity/ref/handle collapse.

phases.title: Define Relevance Routing As Typed Inspection Admission
acceptance: UiInspectionQuery, UiInspectionRelevance, and UiRelevanceFilter have one explicit layering relationship and one ordinary narrowing model
relevance outcomes distinguish matched, empty_local, unsupported_scope, contradictory_request, budget_exceeded, and not_applicable_to_target posture
cross-family expansion requires named families or link kinds instead of silently widening to inspect-everything behavior
typed target, scope, richness, and budget posture remain machine-checkable on the ordinary path
phases.instructions: Turn relevance into an admitted narrowing boundary. Make contradictory, unsupported, empty, and budget-limited requests structurally distinct before any family-local evidence broadens.
phases.qa_focus: No fuzzy search semantics, no one-size-fits-all empty result, no dual relevance models, and no implicit cross-family widening.

phases.title: Materialize Stable Evidence References Before Rich Detail
acceptance: UiEvidenceRef is generation-bound and carries or binds evidence family, evidence identity, owning authority artifact identity, authority generation, world posture where relevant, and materialization posture
equivalent inspection queries over the same authority generation converge on equivalent refs, while later-generation correspondence is explicit rather than assumed
typed retention and expansion posture distinguish retained, discarded, wrong-generation, not-materialized, and unsupported expansion outcomes
UiInspectionReceipt preserves the original query, selected relevance, richness posture, and evidence-slice reference so later expansion stays auditable
phases.instructions: Make ref stability precise. This phase is about stable handles over a specific authority generation, plus retention and expansion semantics, not about broad family detail yet.
phases.qa_focus: No process-ephemeral refs, no vague stability claims, no stale-ref ambiguity, and no implicit generation correspondence.

phases.title: Index Declaration Identity And Source-Provenance Evidence
acceptance: ordinary lookup exists for UiDeclarationIdentity to evidence refs without scans
source-span lookup binds to typed source artifact identity plus source generation rather than fuzzy text ranges
declaration/source indexes are rebuildable from authority and reproduce the same lookup answers after rebuild
authored lookup does not reopen source parsing or declaration lowering on the ordinary inspection path
phases.instructions: Build the authored-side index lanes first. Keep declaration identity and typed authored provenance explicit and narrow before runtime graph lookup broadens the substrate.
phases.qa_focus: No fuzzy source matching, no source reopening, no scan-first authored lookup, and no declaration/source lane collapse.

phases.title: Index Graph Identity Evidence Neighborhoods
acceptance: ordinary lookup exists for UiGraphNodeIdentity to declaration, admission, and obligation evidence neighborhoods without broad scans
graph-identity lookup remains distinct from authored lookup because it answers runtime-truth questions rather than declaration-truth questions
graph-local evidence indexes rebuild from UiGraphSnapshot-backed authority without renderer-local repair
family-local evidence that depends on graph lookup is not admitted on the ordinary path until its indexed lookup path exists or is explicitly unsupported
phases.instructions: Make graph identity the runtime-side entry key for local evidence neighborhoods. Do not let graph-local inspection fall back to tree walks or declaration-shaped folklore.
phases.qa_focus: No hidden graph scans, no declaration-shaped runtime lookup, no index lag behind authority publication, and no ship-now-scan-later ordinary path.

phases.title: Add Aspect Evidence Families And Aspect Local Indexes
acceptance: published and consumed aspect evidence are admitted as their own family-local projections over declaration and graph authority
producer-side and consumer-side aspect indexes remain distinct and support local aspect inspection without widening into unrelated families
aspect-local requests may include direct provenance refs but do not widen into obligation, measurement, or mounted explanation by default
evidence index updates align transactionally with the owning authority artifact publication that introduced the aspect neighborhood
phases.instructions: Add aspect evidence as its own family. Keep publication and consumption neighborhoods explainable without reinterpreting aspect semantics outside the owning runtime lanes.
phases.qa_focus: No vague related-evidence rows, no aspect recomputation, no cross-family creep, and no unindexed aspect-local ordinary path.

phases.title: Add Obligation Evidence Families On 3.4 Authority
acceptance: obligation evidence consumes UiGraphTouchDescriptor, UiSelectedObligationSet, UiObligationDispatchPlan, UiObligationVerdict, and UiAdmissionReport directly rather than reverse-engineering obligation meaning
selection reason, dispatch posture, verdict posture, denial posture, and retained obligation evidence handles remain structurally distinct
obligation-local queries converge through touch-derived and graph-node-derived routes when they target the same admitted work
hostile callers cannot synthesize inspection-local obligation explanations disconnected from 3.4 authority artifacts
phases.instructions: Ground obligation evidence directly on 3.4 authority. This is about retained legality evidence, not about reopening selection or verdict semantics in the inspection layer.
phases.qa_focus: No obligation archaeology from graph posture, no verdict/denial collapse, no synthetic selection reasons, and no public bypass around 3.4 authority.

phases.title: Define Evidence Slice Assembly As A Derived Projection
acceptance: UiInspectionReceipt and UiEvidenceSlice expose one clear ordinary return shape including query identity, authority generation, outcome, evidence slice reference, family summaries, refs, detail, and omitted-by-budget or omitted-by-scope posture
inspection cost receipts expose index lookups, evidence refs considered, refs returned, materialized records, omitted-by-budget, traversals denied, and broad_scan_used posture
equivalent evidence slices return refs in canonical deterministic order rather than incidental storage order
slice assembly remains a derived projection pipeline and does not mutate runtime authority or index state directly
phases.instructions: Assemble the public projection shape after the family-local and index seams are real. Keep refs, summaries, detail, outcome, and cost visible and structurally separate.
phases.qa_focus: No giant inspect-everything assembler, no hidden cost, no nondeterministic ref ordering, and no slice-as-authority confusion.

phases.title: Ship The First AI Inspection Harness On Real Runtime Evidence
acceptance: AI-targeted inspection uses the same ordinary inspection facade surfaces as other callers
Worth UI can cite Query-owned evidence through a typed foreign-evidence ref rather than copying Query explanation into UI-owned truth
the AI path can inspect declaration identity, source provenance, graph identity, aspect neighborhoods, and obligation neighborhoods through refs-first expansion
existing support-bearing lanes such as UiInspectionSupportReport and UiInspectionClosureReport remain compatible around the richer evidence substrate
phases.instructions: Make the AI path real on the ordinary inspection surface. The harness should cite Query when needed, expand refs iteratively, and never fall back to screenshots, logs, or renderer-local explanation for 3.5-covered truth.
phases.qa_focus: No parallel AI-only protocol, no Query truth copying, no whole-graph dumps as the default AI path, and no facade bypass.

phases.title: Certify Boundary Purity Narrowness And Growth Posture
acceptance: compile-fail, residue, topology, and runtime proof block evidence-authority minting, renderer-local explanation bypass, deep-import public bypass, and broad-scan ordinary paths
the closeout enumerates the exact evidence family, relevance, ref lifecycle, retention, Query-citation, index, slice, cost, and AI-harness lanes 3.5 closes
adding a dummy future evidence family has one obvious structural home and does not require widening generic blobs or creating a second substrate
equivalent inspection queries over the same authority generation converge on equivalent refs, slice shape, and cost posture
phases.instructions: Close the milestone with proof and an exact handoff. Make it mechanically obvious that future measurement, mounted receipt, visual snapshot, replay, and inspector work extend one substrate rather than rebuild it.
phases.qa_focus: No public bypass, no generic evidence bucket, no untracked cost sink, no fuzzy future-family handoff, and no generation-unstable ordinary path.
